765-1479-8337.description:
Play Guildless Commons.
When Guildless Commons enters the battlefield, it, M'Ress, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Guildless Commons trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the M'Ress trigger, creating two 1/1 red Officer creature tokens
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Guildless Commons from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Guildless Commons enters the battlefield, it and M'Ress trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

1436-3301-5261.easyPrerequisites:
Call to Glory is exiled by Isochron Scepter.
Isochron Scepter doesn't have summoning sickness.
1436-3301-5261.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
1436-3301-5261.description:
Animate Isochron Scepter using Tezzeret, Betrayer of Flesh.
Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Call to Glory without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Call to Glory, untapping all creatures you control and giving Samurai you control +1/+1 until end of turn
Repeat from step 2.

1409-2724-8172.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking and pairing again with Wormfang Manta.
When Wormfang Manta leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Wormfang Manta entering does not cause its abillity to trigger due to Karn.
Repeat each turn.

3286-4687-5479.notablePrerequisites: Lost Jitte has at least four counters on it.
3286-4687-5479.description:
Activate Inga and Esika by tapping Gilder Bairn, producing its effect.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on Lost Jitte.
Activate Lost Jitte three times by removing three charge counters from it, untapping three lands.
Activate those lands by tapping them, adding {2}{G/U}.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite counters on Lost Jitte, you may instead double the counters on any other permanents.

2590-3899-5776.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
2590-3899-5776.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies as a Food due to Ygra, Experimental Confectioner's second ability and Ygra trigger.
Resolve the Experimental Confectioner trigger, causing you to create a 1/1 Rat creature token.
Resolve the Ygra trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability
Repeat.

requires.n: Gives +1/+1 counter to creatures that enter

2292-4186-5662--196.description:
Cast Scurry Oak by paying its mana cost.
When Scurry Oak enters, the effect that adds +1/+1 counters to entering creatures triggers or applies its replacement effect, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, that same effect causes you to place at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Reyhan triggers, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak
Repeat steps 3 and 4 once.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat from step 5.

412-3081-3817-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Ancestor's Chosen.
When Ancestor's Chosen dies, Orah triggers, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters, it triggers, returning Ancestor's Chosen from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 7 life.
When Ancestor's Chosen enters, it triggers, causing you to gain 1 life for each card in your graveyard.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Sister Hospitaller.
When Sister Hospitaller dies, Orah triggers, allowing you to return a Cleric with mana value 5 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

2421-3705-5231-7646.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Squee and Skyfire Phoenix, adding {R}{R}.
Cast Squee from your graveyard by paying {R}{R}.
Skyfire Phoenix triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2034-3490-5070-6996.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2034-3490-5070-6996.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Angelic Chorus triggers, causing you to gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the The Destined White Mage trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

141-6747-7302.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two artifacts.
141-6747-7302.description:
Cast Whirlwind Technique by paying its mana cost reduced by Sami, targeting any applicable target(s).
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost reduced by Sami.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Whirlwind Technique targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve Whirlwind Technique, airbending Naru Meha.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha from exile by paying {0} due to Sami.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5231-6972-7153.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Arcbound Bruiser.
When Arcbound Bruiser dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Bruiser's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Bruiser from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Repeat.

2034-2048-4871-6967-7147.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wretched Throng, adding {C}{C}.
When Wretched Throng dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Holding priority, activate Epitaph Golem by paying {2}, putting Wretched Throng from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Wretched Throng trigger, putting Wretched Throng from your library into your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Wretched Throng by paying {U} due to Honest Rutstein.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

1719-5921-5970-7060.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Vizier of Tumbling Sands.
Activate one of the Vizier of Tumbling Sands tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Vizier of Tumbling Sands token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

1115-1563-3490-7075.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that has not been tapped this turn.
1115-1563-3490-7075.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

2060-4415-6747-6930.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two artifacts.
2060-4415-6747-6930.description:
Cast Stonecloaker by paying {W}.
Spider-Man India triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler.
When Stonecloaker enters, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {W}.
Repeat.

1913-2073-6797--90.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the artifact with mana value 1 or less.
Activate Salvaging Station by tapping it, returning the artifact from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Imotekh's first ability triggers, creating two 2/2 Necron Warrior artifact creature tokens.
When the Necron Warriors enter the battlefield, Salvaging Station triggers twice, untapping Salvaging Station.
Repeat.

225-774-3257.description:
Activate Patron of the Moon by paying {1}, putting Rakdos Carnarium from your hand onto the battlefield tapped.
When Rakdos Carnarium enters the battlefield, it and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Rakdos Carnarium.
Activate Rakdos Carnarium by tapping it, adding {B}{R}.
Resolve the Rakdos Carnarium trigger from step 2, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

765-1479-2719.description:
Play Guildless Commons.
Kodama of the East Tree, Sakashima of a Thousand Faces, and Guildless Commons trigger.
Resolve the Sakashima of a Thousand Faces trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Guildless Commons trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting Guildless Commons onto the battlefield.
Sakashima of a Thousand Faces and Guildless Commons trigger.
Resolve the Guildless Commons trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the Sakashima of a Thousand Faces token's trigger, putting Guildless Commons onto the battlefield.
Kodama of the East Tree and Guildless Commons trigger.
Repeat from step 5.

1110-3310-3490-4050.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a creature with power 1 or greater to enter the battlefield under your control.
1110-3310-3490-4050.description:
Cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
Terror of the Peaks triggers, dealing damage to an opponent equal to the creature's power.
War Elemental's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Terror of the Peaks triggers.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the Terror of the Peaks trigger, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Repeat from step 3.

618-2999-3957-4613.notablePrerequisites: Famished Paladin has at least one +1/+1 counter on it and does not have summoning sickness.
618-2999-3957-4613.description:
Activate Famished Paladin using Kiki-Jiki's ability by tapping it, creating a token copy of itself with haste.
When the Famished Paladin token enters the battlefield, Impassioned Orator triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Each Famished Paladin you control triggers, untapping themselves.
Repeat.
You may also target any nonlegendary creature you control.

654-2692-2893-3430.notablePrerequisites: Fertilid has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
654-2692-2893-3430.description:
Activate Fertilid, searching your library for a basic Forest card, putting it onto the battlefield tapped.
Amulet of Vigor triggers, untapping the land.
Felidar Retreat triggers.
Resolve the Felidar Retreat trigger putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Tap the land for {G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

313-3492-3609.description:
Cast Corpse Dance with buyback by paying {4}{B}, returning Coretapper from your graveyard to the battlefield with haste and returning Corpse Dance to your hand.
Activate Coretapper's first ability by tapping it, putting a charge counter on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Coretapper's second ability by sacrificing it, putting two charge counters on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Magistrate's Scepter's second ability by tapping it and removing three charge counters from it, taking an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, the delayed ability created by Corpse Dance triggers, failing to exile Coretapper since it is not on the battlefield.
Repeat each turn.

2857-4050-4730.notablePrerequisites: Adarkar Valkyrie does not have summoning sickness.
2857-4050-4730.description:
Activate Adarkar Valkyrie by tapping it, making it so the next time Sparring Mummy dies this turn it will be returned to the battlefield.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Sparring Mummy, adding one mana of any color.
Adarkar Valkyrie triggers, returning Sparring Mummy to the battlefield.
Sparring Mummy enters the battlefield, untapping Adarkar Valkyrie.
Repeat.

704-4215-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Elvish Soultiller.
Elvish Soultiller dies, triggering itself and Verdant Succession.
Resolve the Elvish Soultiller trigger, shuffling all Elves or Mutants from your graveyard into your library.
Resolve the Verdant Succession trigger, searching your library for Elvish Soultiller, putting it onto the battlefield and shuffling your library.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to Elvish Soultiller's power.
Repeat.
